name: tmux-cxx
description: Native control for the independent C++ tmux server

scripts.lint: oxlint -c .oxlintrc.json --max-warnings 0 index.cjs session_event_stream.cjs index.d.ts tests tools
scripts.format: oxfmt -c .oxfmtrc.json index.cjs session_event_stream.cjs index.d.ts tests tools package.json tsconfig.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json
scripts.format-check: oxfmt -c .oxfmtrc.json --check index.cjs session_event_stream.cjs index.d.ts tests tools package.json tsconfig.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json
scripts.lint-type-aware: oxlint -c .oxlintrc.json --type-aware --tsconfig tsconfig.json --max-warnings 0 --report-unused-disable-directives-severity error index.cjs session_event_stream.cjs index.d.ts tests tools
